title: packera aurea
intro: Packera aurea, commonly known as Golden Ragwort, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Packera aurea are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of Packera aurea include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
